serviceName.description: The name of the {@link Microservice} used to determine where to send the request.

ifaceTypeName.description:
The name of the interface {@link Type} used when interacting with the target service.
Needed to get the correct {@link Microservice.Config} for determining the target service.

ifaceActionName.description:
The name of the interface {@link Method} used when interacting with the target service.
Needed to determine what {@link Method} to call on {@link Microservice.Proxy#serviceTypeName}.

thisArgJson.description: Part of the HTTP request body. JSON serialized representation of {@link #thisArg}.

argsJson.description: Part of the HTTP request body. JSON serialized representation of {@link #args}.

retrySpec.description: The retry specification used to control automatic retries when the call to the service fails.

title:
Acts as a context provider for {@link Microservice.Proxy}.
Also provides the ability to manipulate {@link Microservice} RPC calls at runtime.
name: Microservice.RpcSpec
